messages:
Morgan (compliance): Auditor asked for chain-of-custody for an RBAC change on 2024-11-15. They requested: KMS CloudTrail (usage/decrypt), RoleBinding pre/post diffs, approval record, mapping of KMS event -> RBAC event, and a short redacted triage note if this was vuln-driven.
Alex (sec-eng): We have rbac-audit logs and approvals-api events. Will prepare a signed manifest (sha256) and README for verification.
Nina (infra): Starting export for window 2024-11-15T02:00:00Z to 2024-11-15T05:00:00Z. Will pull CloudTrail KMS Decrypt/Encrypt and Kubernetes API calls that updated RoleBindings. Writing to s3://evidence-temp/1717723456/snapshot.gz (temp).
Samir (SRE): I'll run make_changeproof to stitch timeline + mapping. Expected outputs: manifest.sha256, mapping.csv (kms_event_id -> rbac_event_id), timeline.csv, timeline_notes.txt. Command I use: `python tools/make_changeproof.py --start 2024-11-15T02:00Z --end 2024-11-15T05:00Z --include rbac_audit,cloudtrail,approvals-api --output s3://redwood-evidence/compliance/1717723456/`
Auditor Jen: Please also include a one-line statement whether any KMS key material was re-imported or rotated in that window; if rotated, provide the rotation event id.
Morgan (compliance): We'll redact full ARNs in the auditor bundle (last 6 chars masked) and note redaction in manifest.redaction_notes. Approver proof will be approvals-api event export + approver email CSV.
Nina (infra): Upload complete. Presigned URL (expires 7 days): https://presign.example/s3/redwood-evidence/compliance/1717723456/changeproof.tar.gz
Nina (infra): Bundle sha256: 3a7f9c2b8d4e6f1b5a9c0e2d4f6b7c8d9e0f1a2b3c4d5e6f7a8b9c0d1e2f3a4
Samir (SRE): mapping.csv and timeline.csv attached in the bundle; manifest includes signed_by: Alex (sec-eng).
Auditor Jen: Received. We'll verify manifest + mapping and follow up with any clarifying Qs. Thanks for the quick turnaround.
Morgan (compliance): Noted. Keeping thread open for follow-ups.
